id.docs:
**[ID](https://esphome.io/guides/configuration-types#id)**: Manually specify the ID used to reference this component.

*See also: [RP2 BLE Tracker](https://esphome.io/components/rp2_ble_tracker#configuration-variables)*

rp2040_ble_id.docs:
**[ID](https://esphome.io/guides/configuration-types#id)**: Manually specify the ID of the [RP2040 BLE](https://esphome.io/components/rp2040_ble/) component this tracker uses.

*See also: [RP2 BLE Tracker](https://esphome.io/components/rp2_ble_tracker#configuration-variables)*

active.docs:
**boolean**: Whether to send scan requests asking devices for more data after their advertisement. The scan response arrives as a separate report; it is not merged into the advertisement. Turning this off saves power on the advertising devices and radio time on the shared CYW43439. Defaults to `true`.

*See also: [RP2 BLE Tracker](https://esphome.io/components/rp2_ble_tracker#configuration-variables)*

continuous.docs:
**boolean**: If true, scanning starts at boot and runs forever. If false, scanning does **not** start automatically; a scan must be started from a lambda (`id(my_tracker).start_scan();`) and stops again after `duration`. Defaults to `true`.

*See also: [RP2 BLE Tracker](https://esphome.io/components/rp2_ble_tracker#configuration-variables)*

duration.docs:
**[Time](https://esphome.io/guides/configuration-types#time)**: Length of one scan period. In continuous mode the scan period restarts every `duration`; in non-continuous mode the scan stops after this long. Must cover at least three scan intervals. Defaults to `5min`.

*See also: [RP2 BLE Tracker](https://esphome.io/components/rp2_ble_tracker#configuration-variables)*

interval.docs:
**[Time](https://esphome.io/guides/configuration-types#time)**: How often the radio opens a scan window. The controller accepts 2.5 ms to 10240 ms in 0.625 ms steps. Defaults to `100ms`.

*See also: [RP2 BLE Tracker](https://esphome.io/components/rp2_ble_tracker#configuration-variables)*

window.docs:
**[Time](https://esphome.io/guides/configuration-types#time)**: How long the radio listens within each interval. Must not be larger than the interval; the same range and step apply. Defaults to `30ms`.

*See also: [RP2 BLE Tracker](https://esphome.io/components/rp2_ble_tracker#configuration-variables)*

scan_parameters.docs:
Tune how the scan runs.

*See also: [RP2 BLE Tracker](https://esphome.io/components/rp2_ble_tracker#configuration-variables)*
